asked.item: Does muting the preview player carry over to the export?
What else do they need to do to remove the music

verdict.reason: The pages say muting the preview player does not change the exported file, and they describe muting the sound track and then re-exporting.

steps.text: Muting the browser or preview player does not change the exported file.
Select the sound track on the timeline, find Volume in its settings, and click Mute or set its volume to 0%.
Video edits do not carry into a downloaded MP4 until you re-export the video, because the Download button still uses the last exported version.
